description: Class representing the collection of all tables of figures in a document.

Add.description: Adds a table of figures to the document and returns it.

params.description: The range that the table of figures replaces. If omitted, the table of figures is inserted at the current position.
params.name: oRange

Add.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
Add.signature: Add(oTofPr?: TofPr, oRange?: ApiRange): ApiTableOfFigures | null

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTablesOfFigures class.
GetClassType.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetCount.description: Returns the number of tables of figures in the document.
GetCount.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetItem.description: Returns the table of figures at the specified position in the collection.

params.description: The position (zero-based) of the table of figures.
params.name: nIndex

GetItem.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetParent.description: Returns the document that owns this collection.
GetParent.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
